rachel: quick heads-up from marlin-48k onboarding: enabling the new 'compress-priming' path caused a reproducible loss of grounding starting ~32k tokens. Repro steps + minimal artifacts below.

rachel: repro (local):```
RUNTIME=dev ./onboard.sh --model marlin-48k-int3 --ctx 48k --priming compress-priming --quant int3 --seed 1337 > /tmp/marlin-compress.log 2>&1
```

rachel: tiny prompt: system="Answer concisely and cite facts." + ~11k token doc block + 4k question.

rachel: baseline (no compress @40k): "Answer: 19. Explanation: ..."
rachel: compress-enabled (40k): "I don't know what you mean."

miguel: uhoh. any KV metrics at divergence? ropy/rotary meta?

rachel: yes: kv_entries ~32013, rotary_scale per-layer ~1.0 +/-0.002. Memory stable.

darya: we've seen similar before when position anchoring was biased. Which anchoring math does compress-priming use? floor or nearest?

miguel: found the compress diff: commit b7c4a5 in kv_compress.py changed anchor calc to floor-anchor:```
# compress anchoring
anchor = (orig_pos // stride) * stride  # floor anchor (new)
# previously used: anchor = round(orig_pos / stride) * stride
```

darya: floor introduces up to -0.5*stride systematic bias. For long contexts that maps to non-trivial RoPE phase offsets -> potential cancellation on attention heads.

sam: can we dump attention mass for a token around the 32k breakpoint (few layers/heads) before/after compress? even topk sums is fine.

rachel: sanitized snippet from logs:```
[no-compress] layer11 head4 topk-attn-sum=0.84 tokens 31992-32002
[compress]    layer11 head4 topk-attn-sum=0.10 tokens 31992-32002
```

miguel: that looks like destructive interference. simple test: switch anchor calc to nearest (round) and re-run a small compare. I'll kick a CI job.

ci-bot: Job queued: marlin-compress-anchor-compare (owner: miguel). Cluster: pepper. https://ci.redwood/org/jobs/3187776600

darya: also flag quant path — int3 rounding/reshape could amplify tiny phase deltas. Add a run with --quant-skip-reshape so we can isolate compress->rope effects.

miguel: update: rounded-anchor run finished. layer11 head4 topk ~0.79 now. Eval CE improved 3.7 -> 2.0. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/org/artifacts/3187776600/diff.txt

sam: good signal. PR guidance: prefer nearest-anchor when compressing priming; add unit that simulates random orig_pos and stride and asserts max RoPE phase delta < 1e-3.

darya: agree. also add a small numeric tolerance test for quantized path (int3/int4) to ensure accumulation/reshape doesn't magnify phase drift.

rachel: I'll file the onboarding ticket and attach logs+artifact links. Proposed blurb for model onboarding: "compress-priming must preserve positional anchors using nearest rounding; floor-based anchors introduce systematic phase bias that can cause attention collapse around 32k+ contexts."

miguel: followups: (1) change anchor calc to nearest in compress-priming PR, (2) add RoPE-delta unit test in tests/unit/rope_anchor_test.py, (3) run int3/int4 quant variants with --quant-skip-reshape, (4) add a note in the model catalog recommending compress-priming off by default for ctx>=48k until validated.

sam: assigning: miguel=PR, rachel=onboarding ticket + logs, darya=unit tests. I'll validate CI artifacts and close the triage once quant runs complete. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Job finished: marlin-compress-anchor-compare (status: success). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/org/artifacts/3187776600
